objective: Each Hexbound foe has its own line on the card under the cursor in a fight (SHANNON, 2026-11-25: 'give all the enemies their descriptions for their little drop thingy').
acceptance_criteria: Every foe in StationConfig.FOES has `about`: what it is and how to beat it, true to its role, group, stats and ability, 20 to 100 characters
The fight's glass card shows a foe's own line in place of the shared power words
verification: Lune spec: every foe has a line of 20 to 100 characters.
notes: Display text only: no rule reads `about`. The lines follow the rules: defence foes must be struck first (BattleRules.GUARD), the Battle Priest heals (HEAL_PCT), pack foes are stronger together, revive and sweep are the Necromancer's and the golem's and dragons' powers.
